title: Change the details on a conditional vehicle registration
summary: You can change the conditions, number plates, or engine number details of your conditional vehicle registration at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If you need to change the conditions of operation, number plates or engine number details of your conditional vehicle registration, you can do so at a Service NSW Centre.

Note: When you sell a vehicle with conditional registration, you need to cancel the registration and return the number plates. The new owner must apply for a new conditional registration – it can't be transferred.
what_you_need: Your current Certificate of Conditional Registration
Your current Certificate of Approved Operations
The PDF form: Change of Records

how_to_steps.text: Make sure you have all the required documents and your current number plate(s).
Visit a service centre to submit your changes.
